title: Mission create fails with 'Authentication required' — wire VaultUnlockDialog into create flow
description: POST /api/field-ops/missions requires owner auth when status=active, but MissionFormDialog has no vault unlock integration. The /field-ops dashboard silently fails; the /field-ops/missions page surfaces the toast 'Authentication required. Unlock the vault or provide masterPassword.' Fix: call useVaultSession at both call sites — on submit, if !active, stash payload and open VaultUnlockDialog; after unlock, retry the POST. Matches the existing pattern in /field-ops/missions/[id]/page.tsx.

title: feat(ai): chat → tasks planner (clarify then propose, preview & confirm)
description: Adds an AI-powered 'Plan tasks from chat' flow in the venture chat tab. AI scans the thread + project context; if ambiguous, asks up to 3 clarifying questions in a dialog modal; then proposes tasks the user can edit and confirm before they hit /api/tasks. Implementation: src/lib/ai/task-planner.ts (TDD), src/app/api/ai/plan-tasks/route.ts, src/components/plan-tasks-dialog.tsx, button in src/components/chat-tab.tsx.
